headline: IRGC ballistic-missile strikes on US bases in Jordan (+ claimed strikes on Bahrain, Kuwait, Iraq) after US Larak Island strike
dek: Iran's IRGC launched a combined drone/ballistic-missile operation ('Punishment of the Aggressor') against US forces at King Hussein and Al-Azraq air bases in Jordan as retaliation for the US CENTCOM strike on two Iranian launchers on Larak Island Sunday night; IRGC also claimed strikes on…
sources: IRGC statement via Sepah News (official outlet); CENTCOM statement (via Axios/bankb.it); Jordan Armed Forces; Reuters-sourced US official
fault_line: Did Iran actually hit US bases, or did air defenses stop everything? — the claims vs. intercept gap is where the argument lives.

sections.what_happened: Iran's IRGC launched a combined drone/ballistic-missile operation ('Punishment of the Aggressor') against US forces at King Hussein and Al-Azraq air bases in Jordan as retaliation for the US CENTCOM strike on two Iranian launchers on Larak Island Sunday night; IRGC also claimed strikes on US-linked sites in Bahrain (Fifth Fleet/Sheikh Isa), Kuwait (Ali Al Salem, Ahmad Al Jaber) and Erbil, Iraq. CENTCOM: missiles were launched 'in an attempted surprise attack on US forces based in the Middle East' at 5:45pm ET, all intercepted. Jordan intercepted 8-10 missiles, reports no casualties/no material damage. US official (Reuters/NY Post relay): nearly all Iranian missiles/drones intercepted, no confirmed casualties or major damage to US installations. Trump (Fox News): US air defenses downed all missiles that could cause damage; claims US and Iran in 'very friendly' negotiations. Iranian damage claims (F-35 hangar destroyed, command centers hit, American fatalities) are CONTESTED and unverified. US official told CNN the US Larak strikes were a 'warning shot.' Iranian Red Crescent claims 4 killed incl. a child and 50+ wounded when US missile shrapnel hit a wedding in Kuhestak, Iran — ATTRIBUTED ALLEGATION, unverified.
sections.what_verified: Launches confirmed by both sides (IRGC admission + CENTCOM/Axios + Jordan Armed Forces intercept count). US Larak Island strike Sunday night confirmed by CENTCOM (targeted two launchers preparing mine-laying rockets near Hormuz). Oil-market corroboration: WTI +2.47% ($85.46), Brent +2.71% ($90.49) in early Asian trading Monday (bankb.it).
sections.what_disputed: Damage claims conflict sharply: IRGC claims heavy damage to F-35 hangars/command centers; Jordan says intercepted with 'no injuries or material damage'; CENTCOM/US official: all intercepted, no confirmed casualties/damage. republicanjournal.org (low-tier partisan outlet) claims American fatalities — NO primary source, treat as unreliable gossip. Trump simultaneously claims 'friendly' negotiations.
sections.why_matters: Iran retaliates openly for a US strike on its territory — the exchange is confirmed, the damage claims are the information war. Lead with what is verified (missiles flew, both sides admit it), label the contested claims, and frame Iran's declared red line: any strike on Iran meets a direct answer.

Lead with what is verified (missiles flew, both sides admit it), label the contested claims, and frame Iran's declared red line: any strike on Iran meets a direct answer.
